40 Best Ground Sausage Recipes

  • By Irena Macri
  •  | Published: Oct 2, 2026
  •  | 0 Comments
  •  | ★ Leave a review
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by

Instaread

Got a pack of ground sausage in the fridge and no plan? This roundup has you covered, with 40 easy ground sausage recipes for breakfast, lunch and dinner. You’ll find creamy pastas, cozy soups, stuffed veggies, pizzas, flaky pastries and plenty of one-pan meals.

Jump to:
🍝 Pasta (Including Soup Pasta)
🍳 Breakfast
🫑 Stuffed Veggies & Appetizers
🍕 Pizza & Flatbread
🥐 Pastries, Pies & Party Bites
🍲 Easy Dinners

Ground sausage means slightly different things depending on where you live. In the US, it’s usually sold loose in a pack or tube, like breakfast sausage or Italian sausage, mild or hot, and ready to crumble straight into the pan. In Australia, you might see it labeled sausage mince. In the UK, it’s usually called sausage meat. You can also squeeze your favorite sausages out of their casings, which is what I do most of the time. Whatever you call it, it’s pre-seasoned meat that does half the flavor work for you.

I spend a slightly embarrassing amount of time scouring blogs, Pinterest and Instagram for recipes that are actually worth making. So I pulled the best ones into a collection you can bookmark and come back to. Honestly, it’s as much for me as it is for you. It’s for those nights when I open the fridge, spot a pack of sausage and draw a complete blank.

Ground Sausage Pasta Recipes

Sausage flavors everything it touches, which makes it brilliant in pasta sauces and pasta soups. These range from speedy weeknight bowls to a proper weekend lasagna.

Creamy Italian Sausage Pasta

This is my own weeknight pasta for when I want something rich and comforting without much effort. Browned sausage, a silky sauce and a pile of pasta is hard to beat.

Creamy Sausage Tortellini Soup

Another one from my kitchen, and it’s pure comfort in a bowl. Cheese tortellini cooks right in the creamy broth, so dinner is basically one pot and a spoon.

Sausage & Peppers Pasta

Sausage and peppers is an Italian-American classic, and tossing it through pasta turns it into a complete meal. It’s colorful, a little sweet from the peppers and very easy to love. Recipe from Plays Well With Butter.

Sweet & Spicy Sausage Lasagna

I picked this one because it puts a fun twist on a lasagna. Mixing sweet and spicy sausage gives you layers of flavor, and it’s the kind of bake I’d happily make for a crowd. Recipe from A Simple Palate.

Creamy Sausage Orzo

Orzo cooks up quickly and soaks up a creamy sauce beautifully, so this feels like risotto without all the stirring. Weeknight comfort food at its best. Recipe from Salt & Lavender.

Tomato Sausage Orzo

This is the tomato-based cousin to the creamy version above. It’s a bit lighter and a little tangier, and it’s still an easy, cozy one-pan dinner. Recipe from Taming Twins.

Sausage Pasta Bake

Pasta bakes are my answer to feeding a hungry family with minimal fuss. Cheesy, saucy and bubbling from the oven, this one’s a crowd-pleaser. Recipe from The Burnt Butter Table.

Easy Lasagna Soup

You get all the flavors of lasagna without the layering, and it cooks in one pot. It’s been all over my social feeds for good reason. Recipe from Salt & Lavender.

Ground Sausage Breakfast Recipes

Breakfast sausage is made for mornings, and these recipes cover everything from lazy weekend brunches to grab-and-go breakfasts you can prep ahead.

Breakfast Sausage Burger

This is my weekend brunch burger, a juicy sausage patty stacked with all the breakfast trimmings. It’s messy in the best way, so have napkins handy.

Sausage Breakfast Casserole

A breakfast casserole is my secret weapon for holidays and houseguests. You can prep it ahead, bake it in the morning and feed a whole table with one dish. Recipe from A Spicy Perspective.

Breakfast Sausage Burritos

Soft scrambled eggs and savory sausage wrapped up in a tortilla make a hearty breakfast you can eat on the go. I like making a batch and freezing them for busy mornings. Recipe from FoodieCrush.

Sausage & Egg Breakfast Quesadillas

These are crispy, cheesy and on the table fast. I love them for using up leftover breakfast bits, and kids tend to go for them too. Recipe from Budget Bytes.

Baked Breakfast Sausage Hash

I trust Nagi’s recipes completely, and this oven-baked hash is a great hands-off brunch. The potatoes go golden and crispy while you get on with your coffee. Recipe from RecipeTin Eats.

Breakfast Sausage Sandwich

Sometimes you just want the classic. A homemade sausage, egg and cheese sandwich beats the drive-thru version every time. Recipe from Tatyana’s Everyday Food.

Sausage Biscuits & Gravy

This Southern breakfast icon absolutely deserves a spot on this list. Fluffy biscuits smothered in peppery sausage gravy make a must-try if you’ve never had it. Recipe from Tastes Better From Scratch.

Cheesy Sausage Muffins

Savory muffins packed with sausage and cheese are perfect for lunchboxes, snacks or breakfast on the run. They also freeze well, which is always a win in my house. Recipe from MamaGourmand.

Sausage-Stuffed Veggies & Appetizers

Ground sausage makes a flavorful filling for just about anything you can hollow out. Some of these are hearty enough for dinner, and others are made for passing around at a party.

Sausage Stuffed Zucchini

This is one of my favorite ways to use up a glut of zucchini. The sausage filling brings the flavor, and the zucchini keeps it on the lighter side. Recipe from Sip and Feast.

Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms

These are a party appetizer that always disappears first. They’re bite-sized, savory and easy to make ahead. Recipe from Baker by Nature.

Sausage Stuffed Peppers

Stuffed peppers are a classic for a reason: they’re colorful, filling and practically a complete meal in one. Swapping the usual beef for sausage adds loads of extra flavor. Recipe from Sally’s Baking Addiction.

Sausage Stuffed Jalapenos

If you like a bit of heat, these are for you. Creamy, cheesy and spicy, they make a great game-day snack. Recipe from Simple Joy.

Sausage Pizza & Flatbread

Sausage is one of the best pizza toppings there is, and these recipes show just how versatile it can be, from classic combos to something a little different.

Fennel & Sausage Pizza

Fennel and sausage were made for each other, and this pizza shows it off. It’s a combination I order every time I see it on a menu. Recipe from Kitchen Konfidence.

Pesto Sausage Flatbread

Flatbread pizzas are my shortcut to a fun, low-effort dinner. Bright pesto and savory sausage make this one ideal for a quick meal or a casual get-together. Recipe from Nourish and Fete.

Spicy Sausage & Broccoli Pizza

As a sourdough baker, I had to include this one. Spicy sausage and broccoli might sound unusual on pizza, but trust me, it works. Recipe from Vikalinka.

Sausage Mushroom Pepper Pizza

This is the classic pizzeria-style combo you can make at home. It’s loaded with toppings and always a family favorite. Recipe from Cherry on My Sundae.

Sausage Pastries, Pies & Party Bites

Wrap sausage in pastry and you’ve basically guaranteed empty plates. These are my favorites for entertaining, lunchboxes and any time you need a crowd-pleaser.

Sausage Cheese & Onion Puffs

These golden, flaky little bites make an easy party snack that tastes like you tried much harder than you did. Recipe from Don’t Go Bacon My Heart.

Italian Sausage Arugula Quiche

Quiche is my go-to for brunch gatherings, and sausage with peppery arugula makes this one feel a little special. It’s also lovely served cold the next day. Recipe from The Defined Dish.

Cheesy Sausage Puff Pastry Slice

These are easy puff pastry appetizers that look fancy but come together quickly. They’re great when friends pop over unexpectedly. Recipe from Olive & Mango.

Italian Sausage Rolls

Sausage rolls are an Aussie institution, and this Italian-style version puts a fun spin on the classic. You’ll want to make a double batch. Recipe from Sugar Salt Magic.

Sausage Egg & Cheese Hand Pies

Your favorite breakfast sandwich, tucked inside flaky pastry. These are perfect for brunch or breakfast on the go. Recipe from The Worktop.

Spicy Italian Slab Pie

A slab pie feeds a crowd with far less fuss than lots of individual pies. This one is hearty, a bit spicy and great for potlucks. Recipe from All That’s Jas.

More Easy Ground Sausage Dinners

Here are the rest of my favorites: meatballs, soups, skillets, rice dishes and a holiday classic. There are plenty of ideas to get you through the week.

Italian Sausage Meatballs

Using sausage for meatballs is my favorite shortcut, because it’s already seasoned. That means less work and more flavor. Serve them with pasta, in a sub or on their own. Recipe from Baker by Nature.

Sausage Kale & White Bean Soup

Pinch of Yum is one of my all-time favorite blogs, and this soup is hearty, healthy-ish and very cozy. It’s the kind of bowl I crave as soon as the weather cools down. Recipe from Pinch of Yum.

Cajun Dirty Rice

Dirty rice is a Louisiana classic packed with bold, smoky, spicy flavor. It works as a side or a meal on its own. Recipe from This Silly Girl’s Kitchen.

Sausage Peppers Rice Skillet

A one-skillet dinner with sausage, peppers and rice means minimal washing up and maximum flavor. That’s my idea of a good weeknight. Recipe from Averie Cooks.

Beef & Italian Sausage Chili

Adding Italian sausage to chili gives it such a rich, savory depth. It’s a big-batch recipe that tastes even better the next day. Recipe from Espresso and Lime.

Sausage Mushroom Pasta For Two

This is a cozy, creamy pasta scaled down for date nights or when it’s just the two of you. There’s no drowning in leftovers. Recipe from Chocolate Moosey.

Zuppa Toscana

This famous Olive Garden copycat is creamy, with potatoes, sausage and kale. It’s a must-make soup if you haven’t tried it yet. Recipe from Creme de la Crumb.

Skillet Cabbage & Sausage

This one is budget-friendly, low-carb and surprisingly delicious. Cabbage turns sweet and tender when it’s cooked with sausage, and it’s a dish my Eastern European side really appreciates. Recipe from Wyse Guide.

Sausage Cabbage & White Bean Skillet

Beans make this cabbage and sausage skillet more filling. It’s a healthy-ish one-pan dinner that doesn’t feel like a compromise. Recipe from The Modern Proper.

Sausage Stuffing

No holiday table is complete without stuffing, and sausage makes it extra savory. It’s a classic I always make for Thanksgiving or Christmas. Recipe from The Modern Proper.
